name: Assassin Lesson ~Tsuioku no Youin Shoujo~
source:
Girl kills her mother and just sits outside in despair. Main character is a British intelligence agent who offers her to become assassin agent in exchange for protection. Her training includes various techniques including sex ones.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-march-2004-remember11-age.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
亲手弑母的少女绝望地呆坐在门外。身为英国情报局特工的男主角向她开出条件：只要她愿意接受训练成为暗杀特工，便为她提供庇护——而等待着少女的特训科目五花八门，其中更少不了床上侍奉的色情调教。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-march-2004-remember11-age.html]vndbreview[/url]]
